justification: GST-3562 letter A (Garry 'Do it' 2026-11-23 to the /ship simplification cut list; Captain GStack Minder's CREW rule 15 ruling, approval a-6ec01c09edf8: "Only B removes a reader that can block a merge. A replaces narrow re-checks with full rounds, K and L remove audits that never block, and F only reorders; none can lose a catch the panel makes."). Deterministic no-loss replay, no paid run: main's transition table frozen at 0408128 (test/fixtures/review-depth-main/next-step-0408128.ts) against this branch's nextStep over 3,932,160 History cases (passes 0-3; last none, full or fix-check; every mix of the four fix flags; range runtime lines unset, null, 0, 5 and 500; pass-1 and step depth unset, light, standard and full; gate, Step 11 run and lean on and off; 0 or 1 fix-checks; 0-3 prior full rounds; with and without a recorded grant and a round grant). 2,757,344 are identical. Every other case is one of five kinds that add review or move a decision to the lane's Captain, never drop a read of changed code: (a) a planned fix-check becomes a full pass on the same range, 133,120; (b) the same stop, voices or done step with reworded reason text, 897,760; (c) a fix-check after a read-only full review, or one a grant bought at the PR's round cap, becomes a stop for the Captain (on gate class after Step 11's voices), 74,880; (d) a below-floor fix main shipped unread (including a light lean fix that changed runtime lines) becomes a full pass, a read-only full review, or a stop, 46,976; (e) a fixed blocker or gate-class edit at the cap, granted or not, gets one read-only full review of the whole PR diff instead of a stop or a fix-check, 22,080. The lean round 2 that replaces a fix-check keeps the fix-check's second-model reader when published numbers changed. Dispatch equality (added after the read-only review of 6f0f1ba found a docs-only round 2 under review.panel off or risk that dispatched no reader): every kind (a) case must keep main's readers, meaning a full-effort reader that excludes nothing main's fix-check read plus each of main's other readers, so a replacement pass or read-only final review that would dispatch no full-effort reader adds the Red Team reader at full effort on the fix range. test/helpers/gst3562-replay.ts asserts it on every grid, and test/review-depth-lean.test.ts runs the lean table through it (668 kind-a, 100 kind-d and 24 kind-e cases over docs, tests, code, risk and mixed diffs). No reviewer brief, checklist or finding rule changes. The grid no-loss checks in test/review-depth.test.ts, test/review-risk-token-paths.test.ts and test/review-targeted.test.ts read each changed case back as main's plan through planReviewAt and assert these kinds.
